objective: Implement and directly verify the only M449 conditional survivor: combine one exact M433 PWP delta with one signed-INT8 correction operand in the same accepted request while preserving downstream old_psum accumulation.

resource_contract.pwp_source: Reuse the admitted M433 PWP-cache low8/high4 co-read: 144 logical bytes and 160 physical signal bytes per accepted PWP.
resource_contract.correction_source: Reuse one existing 96-byte correction-weight SRAM read. No correction SRAM port is added or widened.
resource_contract.new_datapath: 96 independent signed pre-add/subtract lanes; signed12 PWP plus signed8 correction produces signed13 update_delta.
resource_contract.instantaneous_payload_interpretation: 160 PWP physical signal bytes plus 96 correction bytes from distinct already-required memories. This is not a 160-byte total-port design and it is not power-free.

semantic_contract.plain_request: When fusion is disabled, every correction-side signal must be zero and signed12 PWP is sign-extended to signed13.
semantic_contract.fused_request: Correction tag/tile/output-block must equal the PWP request. correction_subtract selects PWP-W; otherwise PWP+W.
semantic_contract.arithmetic: Each correction source residual is exactly +1 or -1, so one sign bit is shared across all 96 signed-INT8 weight lanes. The result is exact signed13 update_delta.
semantic_contract.accumulation: The output is update_delta only; downstream must perform new_psum=old_psum+sum(all update_delta chunks).

opportunity_boundary.scope: four frozen H67 ep35 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators only
opportunity_boundary.interpretation: The cycle value remains an exact trace opportunity until a scheduler, full runtime replay, unchanged-Fmax physical result, and resource/power audit admit it. It is not RTL-measured or system speedup.

illegal_conditions: narrow PWP with any nonzero high-side data or metadata
plain PWP with any nonzero correction-side signal
config_reload while output buffered or concurrent request presented
fail_closed_contract.atomic_behavior: Any illegal request suppresses request accept and contribution valid/accept in the same cycle, sets sticky protocol_error, and remains quiescent until reset.

decision_rule: Exact-SHA VCS and all directed/SVA gates must pass. Independent hammer is mandatory before DC, Formality, PT, cycle admission, or paper use.
red_lines: Do not cite 1.20199x as measured hardware speedup before executable cycle replay and physical unchanged-Fmax/resource checks.
Do not describe concurrent reads from two existing memories as a 160-byte total-port implementation or a power-free upgrade.
Do not restore or cite the revoked M426 seed-fusion cycles or overwrite semantics.
Do not call this four-Conv standalone probe a full-network or system speedup.
